info.title: x-ai-gateway Public API
info.description: 公开接入面的最小 OpenAPI 事实源，按 OpenAI 标准功能区覆盖 docs、OpenAI-compatible、Claude/Gemini/Vertex 功能性入口、Codex Responses smoke 边界和 Media provider matrix。

get.description: Returns local stored Responses from gateway cache; OpenAI Direct stored Responses with upstream lineage are synced from the original upstream Response first. If the local object is missing, model query or X-AI-Gateway-OpenAI-Model can explicitly route an unknown remote resp_ id to OpenAI Direct.

parameters.name: responseId
parameters.description: Stored Response id.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional OpenAI Responses fields to include. Local stored baseline accepts this parameter as a no-op; OpenAI Direct objects with upstream lineage or explicit route hints forward it upstream.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Gateway route hint for unknown remote OpenAI Direct resp_ ids that do not have local lineage.

parameters.name: X-AI-Gateway-OpenAI-Model
parameters.description: Gateway route hint header for unknown remote OpenAI Direct resp_ ids that do not have local lineage.

delete.description: Deletes local stored Responses; OpenAI Direct stored Responses with upstream lineage issue DELETE to the original upstream Response before marking the local object deleted. Unknown remote resp_ ids require an explicit model route hint.

parameters.name: responseId
parameters.description: Stored Response id.

parameters.description: Gateway route hint header for unknown remote OpenAI Direct resp_ ids that do not have local lineage.

post.description: Cancels local background Responses or forwards cancel to the original OpenAI Direct upstream Response when lineage is available. Unknown remote resp_ ids require an explicit model route hint.

post.summary: Create embeddings for functional RAG support
post.description: Creates embeddings through provider-governed routing for retrieval and RAG support. This is a functional supporting surface, not a promise of every upstream embedding parameter.

model.description: Embedding model name or gateway model alias.

input.description: Input string, token array or batched inputs to embed.

encoding_format.description: Optional encoding format such as float or base64 when supported by the routed provider.

dimensions.description: Optional output dimension hint when supported by the routed provider.

user.description: Optional end-user identifier for abuse monitoring.

post.summary: Create audio transcription for multimodal input
post.description: Transcribes an uploaded audio file through provider-governed routing as part of the multimodal conversation support surface.

model.description: Transcription model name or gateway model alias.

response_format.description: Optional response format when supported by the routed provider.

temperature.description: Optional temperature, accepted as multipart text.

timestamp_granularities[].description: Optional timestamp granularity hints preserved as multipart text values.

include[].description: Optional extra response fields preserved as multipart text values when supported by the routed provider.

stream.description: Optional streaming flag accepted as multipart text; provider support is route-dependent.

post.summary: Create audio translation for multimodal input
post.description: Translates an uploaded audio file through OpenAI-style resource routing when the selected provider exposes an equivalent audio translation surface.

model.description: Translation model name or gateway model alias.

response_format.description: Optional response format when supported by the routed provider.

temperature.description: Optional temperature, accepted as multipart text.

post.summary: Create speech audio for multimodal output
post.description: Generates speech audio through provider-governed routing for multimodal response output.

model.description: Speech model name or gateway model alias.

input.description: Text input used to generate speech audio.

voice.description: Voice identifier supported by the routed provider.

response_format.description: Optional audio format such as mp3, wav or opus.

speed.description: Optional playback speed hint when supported.

post.summary: Create image generation for multimodal output
post.description: Creates image generations through provider-governed routing for the multimodal output surface.

model.description: Image model name or gateway model alias.

size.description: Optional image size supported by the routed provider.

quality.description: Optional quality hint supported by the routed provider.

response_format.description: Optional response format such as url or b64_json.

input_fidelity.description: Optional input fidelity hint when supported by the routed provider.

response_format.description: Optional response format such as url or b64_json.

user.description: Optional end-user identifier for abuse monitoring.

post.summary: Create a local OpenAI Vector Store
post.description: Creates a gateway-local Vector Store lifecycle object. File ids are attached as local references with local chunk ingestion metadata; local content read and local text search are available, while hosted OpenAI embedding/vector index ingestion is not implemented in this baseline.

file_ids.description: Local file ids to associate as references. Local chunk ingestion metadata, content read and local text search are available; hosted OpenAI embedding/vector index ingestion is not implemented in this baseline.

expires_after.description: OpenAI expires_after object, for example anchor=last_active_at and days=7.

post.summary: Search a local OpenAI Vector Store
post.description: Searches persisted local ingestion chunks first with a deterministic UTF-8 lexical baseline, and falls back to raw gateway file text for legacy attachments. This does not perform hosted OpenAI semantic vector retrieval or rerank.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

query.description: Search query string or string array. Local baseline accepts either shape.

filters.description: Attribute filter tree over vector_store.file attributes. Supports eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/in/nin and and/or.

max_num_results.description: Maximum local results to return. Defaults to 10; valid range is 1 to 50.

ranking_options.description: Local lexical score_threshold is honored; ranker is preserved as metadata only.

rewrite_query.description: Accepted as a compatibility no-op in the local lexical baseline.

post.summary: Attach a local OpenAI Vector Store File
post.description: Attaches a file id to a gateway-local Vector Store, reads the current gateway file, and persists local chunk ingestion metadata plus usage_bytes. This does not perform hosted OpenAI embedding/vector index ingestion.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

file_id.description: File id to attach to the local Vector Store.

attributes.description: OpenAI Vector Store File attributes. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans or null.

chunking_strategy.description: OpenAI chunking strategy object. Defaults locally to auto.

get.summary: List local OpenAI Vector Store Files
get.description: Lists gateway-local Vector Store File attachments. Local chunk ingestion metadata, file content read and deterministic local text search are available; hosted OpenAI embedding/vector index ingestion and semantic vector search are not implemented in this baseline.

parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor id of the last Vector Store File from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of Vector Store Files to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by creation time: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional local status filter such as completed or failed.

post.summary: Create a local OpenAI Vector Store File Batch
post.description: Creates a gateway-local vector_store.file_batch and attaches multiple file ids after all duplicate checks pass, persisting local chunk ingestion metadata for each file. This does not perform hosted OpenAI embedding/vector index ingestion.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

file_ids.description: File ids to attach in one local batch. Provide either file_ids or files, not both.

files.description: Per-file batch entries. Each item requires file_id and may include attributes or chunking_strategy.

attributes.description: Attributes applied to every file when file_ids is used.

chunking_strategy.description: Chunking strategy applied to every file when file_ids is used.

post.description: Verifies Standard Webhooks headers against the raw request body and stores valid OpenAI events as gateway-local WEBHOOK_EVENT resources. Duplicate webhook deliveries or duplicate event ids return duplicate=true without another write.

type.description: OpenAI webhook event type such as response.completed.
